# Library-only integration of QuickJS-ng v0.17.0; no libc, CLI or modules.
add_library(MegaVaultQuickJS STATIC quickjs.c dtoa.c libregexp.c libunicode.c)
target_include_directories(MegaVaultQuickJS PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
target_compile_definitions(MegaVaultQuickJS PRIVATE _GNU_SOURCE QUICKJS_NG_BUILD)
set_target_properties(MegaVaultQuickJS PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 11 C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
    C_EXTENSIONS ON POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
if(WIN32)
    target_compile_definitions(MegaVaultQuickJS PRIVATE WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN _WIN32_WINNT=0x0601)
else()
    target_link_libraries(MegaVaultQuickJS PRIVATE m)
endif()
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
target_link_libraries(MegaVaultQuickJS PRIVATE Threads::Threads)
if(MSVC)
    target_compile_definitions(MegaVaultQuickJS PRIVATE _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
    target_compile_options(MegaVaultQuickJS PRIVATE /experimental:c11atomics /wd4996)
else()
    target_compile_options(MegaVaultQuickJS PRIVATE -funsigned-char)
endif()
